scope: 2024 development window only; no 2025 data or scores
hypothesis: For a national holiday that falls Monday through Friday, the historical Sunday-by-period profile may produce a lower forecast error than the ordinary weekday-by-period profile.
primary_selection_metric: global hourly MAE across all 5,016 common development targets
secondary_metrics: MAE on the nine weekday national holidays
support and fallback level for each prediction
unchanged-prediction check on all non-holiday targets

fixed_design.issue_time: 18:00 America/Santiago on the prior calendar day
fixed_design.information_cut: observation_date < issue_date - 60 calendar days; strict date comparison
fixed_design.benchmark: Existing mean by target weekday x source period index, minimum support n>=5, fallback hierarchy unchanged
fixed_design.candidate_rule: On an included national holiday falling Monday-Friday, replace only that target's predicted mean with the historical Sunday x same source period index mean; calculate from that issue's eligible history.
fixed_design.candidate_fallback: Apply the existing support threshold and fallback order by calling the existing benchmark function with weekday=Sunday (Monday=0 ... Sunday=6) and the original period index. If there is no support at any fallback level, do not fabricate a value; mark the target unsupported and fail the experiment coverage gate.
fixed_design.non_holiday_targets: Must retain exactly the existing benchmark prediction.
fixed_design.weekend_holidays_and_election_events: Do not modify in this experiment.
fixed_design.primary_decision_rule: Compare global MAE on identical targets; do not select by holiday-only MAE.
fixed_design.inference_status: Development comparison only; the hypothesis was formulated after inspecting 2024 errors, so results are not an independent confirmation.

calendar_definition.source: Gob.cl, ¿Cuáles son los feriados del 2024? Conoce los irrenunciables
calendar_definition.selection_rule: From the published national 2024 holiday list, include only dates in the fixed development window that fall Monday-Friday. Exclude election days and region-specific holidays. Do not select dates based on observed errors.

included_dates.name: Día Nacional de los Pueblos Indígenas
Día de la Virgen del Carmen
Día de las Glorias del Ejército
Día de las Iglesias Evangélicas y Protestantes

excluded_events.reason: Sunday election; not a weekday holiday treatment.
